whole_job.source: runtime DataStream sequence with nullable BIGINT or DECIMAL(12,2)
whole_job.validation: values and RowKinds compared after each trial; native window nodes and both transposes required in the sink witness

limitations: Small jobs include startup and collection polling; sample ranges must be retained.

Stock medians differ between separate process runs. Initial single-phase DECIMAL samples were near parity; the later same-process stock/native/fallback controls demonstrate a gain at 64 and 4096 keys, without proving a universal speedup.
Allocation requests are not peak memory or copied bytes; zero shared output bytes reflects scalar result reconstruction.
The allocation executable uses CountingAllocator over the system allocator; production whole-job builds use mimalloc.

criterion.profile: release, with mimalloc feature; executable global CountingAllocator delegates to System
criterion.boundary: production COUNT/SUM0 grouping, update, final flush, output disposal and operator teardown; fixture and empty operator construction excluded

same_process_fallback_control.fallback: existing per-operator switches disable single/local/global windows; whole-query gate rolls back all substitutions, verified zero
same_process_fallback_control.validation: full values and RowKinds compared with stock for both native and fallback after every trial
